name: Tou no Shita no Exercitus
original_name: 塔の下のエクセルキトゥス
source:
A long, long time ago, a certain civilization lived in prosperity with its superior technology until it destroyed itself due to over-development. The world was destroyed in this "accident", but it gradually recovered after a long time. However, it was limited only to the areas surrounding the Tower of Velvalem, built by the "family of the dawn".

Then a new problem soon arose. The number of people under the protection of the "tower" had increased too much, causing its circulation ability to become unstable. After plenty of hand-wringing, the leaders at that time created a manic system with "demons" coming out of the tower to attack and reduce the human population, and consequently preserve the balance of the world.

A hundred years later, Melcriti Academy was founded as a training school for adventurers who fight against these demons. They were able to repel them and the population began to increase once more. As a result, Velvalem became unstable and the countdown towards destruction is underway. Yuuki was accidentally summoned by Chloe into this world. He must fight as an adventurer through various challenges along with the heroines.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
很久以前，某个文明凭借先进科技繁荣昌盛，却因过度发展而自我毁灭。世界在这场“事故”中毁灭，经过漫长岁月才逐渐复苏。然而，复苏仅限于“黎明家族”建造的维尔瓦勒姆之塔周边地区。

新的问题很快出现了。受“高塔”庇护的人口越来越多，导致它的循环能力变得不稳定。经过一番苦思，当时的领导者创造出一种疯狂的制度：让“恶魔”从塔中出现，攻击并减少人类人口，从而维持世界的平衡。

一百年后，梅尔克里蒂学园成立，作为培养讨伐这些恶魔的冒险者学校。冒险者们成功击退恶魔，人口再次增加。结果，维尔瓦勒姆变得更加不稳定，毁灭倒计时已经开始。优希意外被克洛伊召唤到这个世界，必须和女主角们一起作为冒险者，迎接各种挑战。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
